correctness.rationale: For every finite field F_q including characteristic two, Heisenberg bracket [x,y]=z and P²⊆kz force z to annihilate P under Leibniz and associativity. Thus all products arise from one nonzero symmetric 2x2 form S with multiplication uv=(u^T S v)z. Put J=[[0,1],[-1,0]], T=J^-1 S. S symmetric iff tr T=0 in all characteristics. Simultaneous Poisson equivalence changes T by GL2 similarity, with arbitrary two-dimensional central shear. Consequently Aut order =q² |C_GL2(T)|; a linear Lie derivation has matrix A on V and D(z)=tr A z, and its multiplication condition is exactly [A,T]=0, giving dimension 2+dim C_M2(T). For odd q the nonzero trace-zero 2x2 similarity classes are q companion-matrix determinant classes including nilpotent and the split/anisotropic subclasses, all with derivation dimension four. For even q they are q nonscalar Jordan classes and q-1 nonzero scalar classes, yielding 2q-1 classes, with scalar derivation dimension six (otherwise four), and the exact orbit/Aut formulas through GL2 centralizers. Directly enumerated GL2 trace-zero conjugation orbits for q=2,3,5: 3,3,5 classes with orbit partitions [1,3,3], [6,8,12], [20,20,24,30,30]; pinned verify.py additionally implements F4 and checks derivative centralizers, none of which substitutes for all-prime-power argument.
